entities.summary: Joseph Astbury Warbrick was a Māori member of the New Zealand national rugby union team on their 1884 tour to Australia. He later captained the 1888–89 New Zealand Native football team that embarked on a 107-match tour of New Zealand, Australia, and the British Isles.
